subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 购物常用语：Can I help you? — Yes, I want a shirt. How much is it? — It's 50 yuan. Can I try it on? — Of course. Here you are. 货币单位 yuan 没有复数形式。
formulas: 示例：How much is the shirt? It's 50 yuan.
cautions: ①yuan 无复数（勿写 yuans）；②How much 问价格，How many 问可数数量，勿混；③try it on 代词放中间（try them on）；④How much is/are 与单复数一致。
